$description: Lumen v0.13 — Phase 0 semantic border namespace. Aliases the existing v0.12.6 `color.border.*` semantic tokens under a flatter `border.*` namespace. The master doc names 6 core roles (hairline, default, strong, frame, accent, focus); Lumen v0.12.6 also ships subtle/error/success/warning/disabled. `border.frame` is the brutalist hairline — explicitly named here as the master doc requires; the v0.12.6 description (`v0.4 — brutalist hairline frame border, hairline-strong`) is preserved verbatim.

hairline.$description: Default hairline — the breathing-room separator (per principles §1, §3). Light: ink-alpha-6%. Dark: paper-alpha-6%. Aliases color.border.hairline.

subtle.$description: Subtle border — one step up from hairline. Aliases color.border.subtle.

frame.$description: THE BRUTALIST HAIRLINE FRAME — the v0.4 voice element. Hairline-strong stroke that frames hero cards, brand surfaces, signature shells. Light: ink-alpha-40%. Dark: paper-alpha-40%. Aliases color.border.frame. (Master doc names this as the canonical voice element.)

accent.$description: Spring-green hairline — accent surfaces. Aliases color.border.accent.

focus.$description: Focus ring color — always paired with shadow.focus + the structural outline per hard rule 11. Light: accent.500. Dark: accent.400. Aliases color.border.focus.
